text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Failing to conquer the Satsuki Sho, the 
long-cherished dream of achieving the 
Triple Crown was dashed early on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, in the face of the crowd's 
unending cheers, Mihono Bourbon resolved 
to keep running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, you set your next sights on the 
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That night, Rice Shower was pouring 
herself into training, saying, "I'm going 
to catch up to Bourbon-san...!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to understand the feeling of 
"frustration," Mihono Bourbon watched over 
Rice Shower with a sense of bewilderment.
